user.title: OBLO Living Cloud
user.description: Log in with your OBLO Living cloud account. Devices are picked up from the cloud automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate OBLO Living
reauth_confirm.description: The cloud session for {identity} expired or was rejected. Enter the password for this OBLO account to renew it.

error.invalid_auth: Cloud rejected these credentials (user does not exist or wrong password). Check the HA log for the exact error code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach cloud.oblo.rs (network error or rate limited).
error.cloud_unavailable: Reached cloud.oblo.rs but it answered with a server error (HTTP 5xx). The cloud service may be down.
error.unexpected_response: Login answered with an unexpected response. Check the HA log for details.
error.missing_credentials: Email and password are both required.
error.rate_limited: The cloud temporarily blocked this account after too many failed login attempts. Even the correct password fails until the block lifts - wait about 15 minutes, confirm the password in the OBLO app or at cloud.oblo.rs, then try once.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
